CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_deletion_activation_authorized(p_job uuid, p_token uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE j public.account_deletion_jobs;
BEGIN
 j:=public.account_deletion_assert_claim(p_job,p_token);
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletion_contract_gate WHERE managed_resources_execution_enabled)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletion_operator_proposal p WHERE p.job_id=j.id AND p.category='recovery'
 AND p.action='activate_destructive_processing' AND p.reference='policy:'||j.policy_version::text
 AND p.decision='approved' AND p.reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND p.reviewed_by<>p.proposed_by)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletion_hold WHERE job_id=j.id AND released_at IS NULL)
 AND public.account_deletion_rule_allowed(j.policy_version,'personal.erase')
 AND public.account_deletion_rule_allowed(j.policy_version,'external.erase')
 AND public.account_deletion_rule_allowed(j.policy_version,'receipt.complete')
 AND public.account_deletion_rule_allowed(j.policy_version,'restore.suppress');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_deletion_contract_status()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',1,'policyVersion',active_policy_version,'requestsEnabled',requests_enabled AND
 public.account_deletion_rule_allowed(active_policy_version,'personal.erase') AND public.account_deletion_rule_allowed(active_policy_version,'external.erase') AND public.account_deletion_rule_allowed(active_policy_version,'receipt.complete') AND public.account_deletion_rule_allowed(active_policy_version,'restore.suppress'))
 FROM public.account_deletion_contract_gate WHERE singleton;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_deletion_monitor(p_actor_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO public.account_deletion_audit(actor_user_id,event_code) VALUES(p_actor_user_id,'monitor_read');
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x),'[]') INTO result FROM (
 SELECT j.id AS "requestId",1 AS "contractVersion",coalesce(j.policy_version,1) AS "policyVersion",
 CASE WHEN j.review_required OR (j.status='completed' AND r.job_id IS NULL) THEN 'manual_review' WHEN j.status='pending' THEN 'restricted' WHEN j.status='retry' THEN 'failed' ELSE j.status END AS status,
 j.stage,j.requested_at AS "requestedAt",j.review_code AS "reviewCode",j.review_due_at AS "reviewDueAt",(j.status='processing' AND j.lease_until<clock_timestamp()) AS stale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM public.account_deletion_review v WHERE v.job_id=j.id AND v.state<>'resolved') AS "openReviews",
 r.completed_at AS "completedAt",r.exception_count AS "retainedExceptions"
 FROM public.account_deletion_jobs j LEFT JOIN public.account_deletion_completion_receipt r ON r.job_id=j.id AND r.policy_version=j.policy_version AND r.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
 ORDER BY j.requested_at DESC LIMIT 100) x;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_account_deletions()
 RETURNS SETOF account_deletion_jobs
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT * FROM public.account_deletion_jobs WHERE false;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_account_deletions(p_contract_version integer)
 RETURNS SETOF account_deletion_jobs
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 UPDATE public.account_deletion_jobs SET status='processing',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=gen_random_uuid(),lease_until=now()+interval '5 minutes'
 WHERE p_contract_version=1 AND id IN (SELECT id FROM public.account_deletion_jobs WHERE status IN ('pending','retry') AND NOT review_required AND lease_token IS NULL AND next_attempt_at<=now() ORDER BY requested_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) RETURNING *;
$function$
